clauses.text: | Network | Annual deductible | Annual out-of-pocket maximum | Excess balance billing |

Calculation and accumulation rules: For covered care apply any remaining deductible first, then the stated copay, then member coinsurance to the remaining allowed amount. Round coinsurance half up to cents. Apply the remaining annual OOP cap to deductible, copay and coinsurance in that order. Only actually assessed covered sharing accrues. In- and out-of-network annual pools are separate. Permitted excess equals charge minus allowance and is outside OOP. Excluded care is full-charge patient liability outside deductible and OOP, with no insurer payment. No excess billing is allowed in network. A waived deductible means no deductible applies to that benefit.
B1: Office visit (CPT/HCPCS 99213), in-network: covered; deductible waived; member copay $45.00; member coinsurance 0%.

Rounding convention: Coinsurance is rounded half-up to cents as an engine convention; the source does not specify rounding.
The source includes a special provision about duplicate billing; this is not encoded as a condition because it does not affect the cost-sharing amount for a single valid claim.
coverage_gaps: No other benefits are listed in the source; only B1 (office visit) is compiled.
No out-of-network benefits are listed; only network-level deductible and OOP are provided.
No balance billing information is provided for out-of-network beyond the permitted statement; no specific billing protection details are given.
The source does not specify whether the deductible waiver for B1 is due to a plan-wide waiver or specific to this benefit; it is encoded as deductible_applies=false for B1 only.
The source does not include any prescription drug, urgent care, emergency room, diagnostic test, imaging, or other common benefit rows; they are omitted.
